# Scout brief: the generation-and-drift machinery SEEN-106 extends

Could not answer: no `--auto` flag on `handoff` and no `--quick` flag on `doctor` exist
anywhere in `harness/cli.py`; both are new surface. Did not trace whether `doctor`'s
success path reaches the shared JSON print.

**Generation and drift.** `harness/agents.py` `sync(root)` (226-237) writes both copies from
each source; `drift(root)` (269-287) re-renders `render_claude` and `render_codex` from the
source and compares the **full text** (`path.read_text() != rendered`), not a hash in a file
and not a marker. The `GENERATED` comment (144-145) names the source but is informational.
`strays(root)` (240-266) flags a copy with no source. Helpers `source_of`, `claude_copy`,
`codex_copy` (148-158). `harness/skills.py` has the same pair: `sync` (46), `drift` (66).
`harness/doctor.py` calls `skills.drift` (145) and `agents.drift` (150).
`harness/triage.py:generated_paths()` (275-293) lists every generated copy so the review
triage does not flag them as unplanned.

**The CLI the hooks call.** `status --brief`: flag at `cli.py:80`, `brief()` at 345,
dispatched 1061-1063. `budget`: `budget()` at 373, dispatched 1059-1060. `handoff`:
`handoff()` at 305, no `--auto`. `doctor`: dispatched at 1020 into `doctor.report(...)`,
no `--quick`. Every command shares one `print(json.dumps(...))` at `cli.py:1099`, so
stdout is JSON; `doctor`'s failure raises through `require()` with plain text (1022-1023).

**Slice plan and branch.** `harness/handoff.py:plan_of(records)` (52-54) reads
`gates.latest_evidence(records, 'solution')['slices']`; `current_slice()` (101-146) returns
the active entry. Per-slice `files` are read by `harness/routing.py:planned()` (134-138) from
`entry['files']`. There is no helper returning the ticket of the current branch:
`cli.py:require_branch()` (225-236) matches `repository.branch_or_none()` against `BRANCH`
and compares `match.group('ticket')`, so it validates rather than returns.

**The two settings files.** `.claude/settings.json` has two top-level keys, `hooks` and
`permissions`; its only hook entries are `PreToolUse` on `Bash|Grep` to
`graphify hook-guard search` and on `Read|Glob` to `graphify hook-guard read`.
`.codex/hooks.json` already exists, hand-maintained, with `SessionStart` and `PostToolUse`
entries running `repowise-augment --client codex`. `.codex/config.toml` and
`.codex/agents/*.toml` exist too.

Not checked: the bodies of `skills.py` `sync` and `drift`, and `doctor.report()`'s success path.
